raw_meta_yaml:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prefix-dev/recipe-format/main/schema.json
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "1.6.2"
  cffi_min: "2.0.0"
  pip_args: pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation --disable-pip-version-check
  # see: https://github.com/pyca/pynacl/blob/main/.github/workflows/wheel-builder.yml
  pip_abi3_args: --config-setting=--build-option=--py-limited-api=cp${{ python_min | replace('.', '') }}

package:
  name: pynacl
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/p/pynacl/pynacl-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 018494d6d696ae03c7e656e5e74cdfd8ea1326962cc401bcf018f1ed8436811c

build:
  skip: is_abi3 and not is_python_min
  number: 5
  python:
    version_independent: ${{ is_abi3 }}
  script:
    env:
      SODIUM_INSTALL: system
    content:
      - if: unix
        then:
          - cp ${BUILD_PREFIX}/share/gnuconfig/config.* ./src/libsodium/build-aux
          - export CPPFLAGS="$CPPFLAGS -I${PREFIX}/include"
      - if: is_abi3
        then:
          - ${{ PYTHON }} -m ${{ pip_args }} ${{ pip_abi3_args }}
        else:
          - ${{ PYTHON }} -m ${{ pip_args }}

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler("c") }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - cffi >=${{ cffi_min }}
    - if: win
      then:
        - m2-patch
      else:
        - gnuconfig
  host:
    - cffi >=${{ cffi_min }}
    - libsodium
    - pip
    - python
    - setuptools
    - wheel
    - if: is_abi3
      then:
        - python-abi3
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
  run:
    - cffi >=${{ cffi_min }}
    - python
    - six

tests:
  - if: is_abi3
    then:
      - python:
          imports:
            - nacl
            - nacl.bindings
            - nacl.pwhash
          pip_check: true
          python_version:
             - ${{ python_min }}.*
             - "*"
    else:
      - python:
          imports:
            - nacl
            - nacl.bindings
            - nacl.pwhash
          pip_check: true
  - if: is_abi3
    then:
      - files:
          source:
            - tests/
        requirements:
          run:
            - abi3audit
            - hypothesis >=3.27.0
            - pytest >=3.2.1
            - python ${{ python_min }}.*
        script:
          - pytest --tb=long --color=yes
          - cd "${{ '$SP_DIR' if unix else '%SP_DIR%' }}/nacl"
          - abi3audit -s -v --assume-minimum-abi3 ${{ python_min }} _sodium.${{ 'abi3.so' if unix else 'pyd' }}
  # this is run (and tests bundled) twice for abi3
  - files:
      source:
        - tests/
    requirements:
      run:
        - pytest >=3.2.1
        - hypothesis >=3.27.0
        - python *
    script:
      - pytest --tb=long --color=yes

about:
  license: Apache-2.0

  summary: PyNaCl is a Python binding to the Networking and Cryptography library, a crypto library with the stated goal of improving usability, security and speed.
  description: |
    PyNaCl is a Python binding to the Networking and Cryptography library, a crypto library with the stated goal of improving usability, security and speed. It supports Python 2.7 and 3.3+ as well as PyPy 2.6+.
  homepage: https://github.com/pyca/pynacl
  repository: https://github.com/pyca/pynacl
  documentation: https://pynacl.readthedocs.io
